channel.title: The Traitors
channel.desc: New day, new drama as the players arrive to a breakfastthat poses more questions than provides answers. It isn'tlong before they take their seats at the Round Table, but can new leads present an opportunity to oust a Traitor, or have the Faithful been hoodwinked? Followinga mission that reveals just how important the players'lives really are to one another, the Traitors are set for an unforgettable night.
